THE WORLD OF DO & CO 

DO & CO is one of the world's leading premium hospitality and catering companies, employing more than 17,000 people across over 20 countries. Our group includes the renowned brands k. & k. Hofzuckerbäckerei Demel, HENRY and HEDIARD. 

DO & CO operates in Austria, Türkiye, Germany, England, Spain, Italy, Poland, South Korea and the United States. 

DO & CO delivers exceptional culinary experiences, from fine-dining to international events such as UEFA Champions League Finals, FIFA World Cups and Formula 1. We combine culinary excellence and outstanding service to create unforgettable experiences worldwide.

Department: Kitchen

Contract Type: Full-time

With the exciting re-opening of ONYX Restaurant in Vienna, you have the opportunity to join our team as an International Sous Chef (m/w/x). Playing a key role in leading the hot kitchen team, maintaining the highest culinary standards and creating exceptional dining experiences from day one.

Your main responsibilities: 

 * Culinary leadership and operational responsibility

 * Ensuring the highest quality and service standards

 * Overseeing food production and ensuring smooth operations throughout daily service

 * Continuous development and refinement of innovative dishes

 * Ensuring compliance with all food safety and hygiene standards

Qualifications

WHAT SETS YOU APART 

 * 6+ years of professional experience in luxury gastronomy and completed culinary training

 * Exceptional knowledge of Japanese-Peruvian cuisine

 * Experience with Mediterranean cuisines such as Turkish, Greek, Italian or Spanish

 * Performance-driven mindset

 * Strong team spirit 

 * Valid work permit for Austria

 * Excellent English skills (written and spoken); other languages are an advantage

Additional Information

YOUR WORKING ENVIRONMENT 

 * A key role within DO & CO's flagship hotel and a highly skilled international kitchen team

 * Exciting mix of traditional restaurant operations and international events

 * Individual long-term career opportunities within the DO & CO Group

 * Opportunity to work at Formula 1 Grand Prix weekends in the Paddock Club®

 * Excellent public transport connections thanks to our central location in the heart of Vienna

 * Daily complimentary freshly prepared lunch and fruit 

OUR ATTRACTIVE OFFER

A gross monthly salary of €5,000 per month on a full-time basis (All-In contract). Willingness to overpay depends on qualifications and individual agreement.

Must be willing to relocate to Vienna. A valid work permit for Austria is required.
